narrative.synopsis: Triptolemus turns Demeter’s restored favor into human culture. Given grain and instruction, he carries agriculture beyond Eleusis and makes the goddess’ gift visible in cultivated fields.
narrative.openingSituation: Demeter’s grief has ended enough for fertility to return.
narrative.centralConflict: The gift of grain must move from divine possession to human practice.
narrative.resolution: Triptolemus receives the task and begins teaching.
narrative.outcome: Agriculture becomes a sacred inheritance from Demeter.
